hero.description: Success Path Mentors connects students with experienced, vetted tutors for personalized, one-on-one support — online or in-home, across every subject and grade level.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.description: To give every student access to personalized, high-quality tutoring that builds real academic confidence — matching each learner with a tutor suited to their pace, learning style, and goals.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.description: A future where every student, regardless of background, has a dedicated mentor to help them reach their full academic potential and develop a lifelong love of learning.

coreValues.title: Our core values
coreValues.description: The principles that guide how we work with students, families, and tutors.

integrity.title: Integrity
integrity.description: We're honest with families about what tutoring can realistically achieve, and how.

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.description: We continually refine our matching and teaching methods based on what actually helps students learn.

excellence.title: Excellence
excellence.description: We hold our tutors and our own processes to a high standard, every session.

studentSuccess.title: Student success
studentSuccess.description: Every decision we make is weighed against one question: does this help the student succeed?

continuousLearning.title: Continuous learning
continuousLearning.description: We believe learning doesn't stop with students — our tutors keep developing their craft too.

professionalism.title: Professionalism
professionalism.description: Families can expect reliability, clear communication, and respect at every step.

flexibleScheduling.title: Flexible scheduling

personalizedLearning.title: Personalized learning

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Common questions about our tutors, process, subjects, and locations.

howAreTutorsSelected.question: How are tutors selected?
howAreTutorsSelected.answer: Every tutor goes through a vetting process that reviews subject expertise and teaching ability before they're matched with students.

howDoesLearningProcessWork.question: How does the learning process work?
howDoesLearningProcessWork.answer: We start with an assessment of the student's current level and goals, then build a personalized learning plan and check in regularly to adjust it as needed.

whichSubjectsAreOffered.question: Which subjects are offered?
whichSubjectsAreOffered.answer: We cover core academic subjects across grade levels. Visit the Subjects page for the full list.

whichLocationsAreServed.question: Which locations do you serve?
whichLocationsAreServed.answer: We offer online tutoring everywhere, plus in-home tutoring in select cities. Visit the Locations page for details.
